irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: A DEFINITION's own internal formula sub-component needs to share an aggregate ceiling with an amount computed under an entirely different, freestanding section (Section 1.07(3)) of the agreement, exactly like the WireSharedCapacity mechanism already available for WireRule baskets.
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: MIN/SUM can approximate a self-contained cap mathematically inline (as done here for the clauses (f)/(l)/(m)/(n) cap that lives entirely within this same definition), but there is no first-class way for a WireDefinition's calculationExpression sub-node to register as a memberRef of a WireSharedCapacity, and WireDefinition itself has no dependsOn-with-relationshipType field analogous to WireRule.dependsOn - so a genuine cross-unit shared ceiling touching a definition (rather than a rule) cannot be modeled without either guessing at the combined amount or abandoning the arithmetic tree.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: Extend WireSharedCapacity.memberRefs to accept definition-internal references (e.g. 'localRef#path') in addition to WireRule localRefs, or add an optional dependsOn array (with relationshipType such as SHARES_CAPACITY_WITH) to WireDefinition mirroring WireRule.dependsOn.
